deductions.label: Zelfstandigenaftrek
deductions.explanation: A fixed deduction for entrepreneurs who spend at least 1.225 hours a year on the business and had not reached AOW age at the start of the year. It cannot exceed your profit, unless you also qualify for the startersaftrek.

deductions.label: Startersaftrek
deductions.explanation: An extra deduction on top of the zelfstandigenaftrek, for up to three of your first five years in business. It is not capped at your profit, so in a lean year it can increase a loss you carry forward.

deductions.label: MKB-winstvrijstelling
deductions.explanation: 12,7% of what is left after the entrepreneur deductions is exempt from income tax. It applies to a loss too, which makes the loss smaller.

credits.label: Algemene heffingskorting
credits.explanation: A credit subtracted from the tax you owe, not from your income. It is the full amount up to €29.736 and then tapers away, reaching zero at €78.427.

credits.label: Arbeidskorting
credits.explanation: A credit for people who work, including self-employed people. It is calculated on your arbeidsinkomen, which counts business profit BEFORE the entrepreneur deductions and the MKB-winstvrijstelling.

rateAdjustment.label: Tariefsaanpassing aftrekposten
rateAdjustment.explanation: Above €78.426 your deductions would otherwise save you tax at 49,50%. A correction of 11,94% is added back so the benefit is capped at 37,56%.

socialContributions.label: Zvw contribution
socialContributions.explanation: The income-dependent healthcare contribution. It is a separate bill from income tax, paid through your assessment, and it is owed even in a year where income tax works out at zero.

assumptions: This is a planning estimate, not tax advice and not an assessment. Your actual bill is set by the Belastingdienst on your annual return.
Figures are for a taxpayer who has not reached AOW age, is taxed as an entrepreneur for income tax (ondernemer voor de inkomstenbelasting), and lives in the Netherlands.
Income tax is assessed once a year on your total profit. This estimate projects the whole year, so it changes as your projected profit changes.

The Zvw base is taken as your profit after the entrepreneur deductions and the MKB-winstvrijstelling. Belastingdienst publishes the rate (4,85%) and the maximum contribution base (€79.409) but does not state the base on its public pages, so this is unconfirmed. See NEEDS_VERIFICATION.md.
The algemene heffingskorting is calculated on your Box 1 income only. Box 2 and Box 3 income are not modelled and would reduce this credit, so anyone with such income will be under-reserved here.
Employment income is counted so the bracket your freelance profit lands in is right. Tax your employer already withheld is only subtracted if you enter it.
The Zvw maximum contribution base is applied to business profit alone. With a job alongside the business the maximum is shared across both, so this estimate can overstate Zvw at high combined income.
Only the zelfstandigenaftrek, the startersaftrek and the MKB-winstvrijstelling are modelled. Investeringsaftrek, meewerkaftrek, stakingsaftrek, fiscale oudedagsreserve and loss carry-forward are not.
Amounts to set aside are rounded up to the whole euro. Under-reserving produces a surprise bill; over-reserving only costs liquidity, and those two are not equally bad.

provenance.note: Box 1 brackets 2026 for people who have not reached AOW age: 35,75% up to €38.883, 37,56% to €78.426, 49,50% above.
Second, independent confirmation of the same three brackets and thresholds.
Premies volksverzekeringen 2026: AOW 17,90% + Anw 0,10% + Wlz 9,65% = 27,65%, levied on income up to €38.883, maximum €10.751.

The 8,10% income tax component of bracket 1 is derived as 35,75% - 27,65%. Belastingdienst publishes the combined rate and the premie rate but not this split. Documentation only; no calculation uses it.
€1.200 for 2026. Requires the urencriterium and not having reached AOW age at the start of the year. May not exceed profit before ondernemersaftrek unless startersaftrek applies.
Urencriterium is at least 1.225 hours a year. Unused zelfstandigenaftrek carries forward 9 years (not modelled).
€2.123 for 2026, if you were not an entrepreneur in one or more of the five preceding calendar years and applied the zelfstandigenaftrek at most twice in that period.
12,7% of profit after it has been reduced by the ondernemersaftrek. Benefit calculated at a rate of 37,56%.
Tariefsaanpassing 11,94% in 2026, applies above €78.426, capping deduction benefit at 37,56%. Belastingdienst names zelfstandigenaftrek and mkb-winstvrijstelling in the covered list.
Not yet AOW age: €3.115 up to €29.736; then €3.115 - 6,398% x (verzamelinkomen - €29.736); €0 from €78.427.
Arbeidsinkomen counts 'winst uit onderneming vóór ondernemersaftrek en mkb-winstvrijstelling', plus wages and resultaat uit overig werk. A different base from the algemene heffingskorting.
Bijdrage Zvw 4,85% for income not subject to employer withholding, including winst uit onderneming. Werkgeversheffing is 6,10% and does not apply here.

UNCONFIRMED. Belastingdienst states the contribution is paid over 'winst uit onderneming' but does not say on any reachable public page whether that is belastbare winst (after ondernemersaftrek and MKB-winstvrijstelling) or profit before those. Configured as belastbare winst. See NEEDS_VERIFICATION.md item 1.
21% standard, 9% reduced, 0% for cross-border supplies. No rate changed for 2026; logies moved from the 9% category to the 21% category on 1 January 2026, which is a classification change.
